# Encoding document fixtures

`aelwythi-semaron.json` contains the executable fields of the Aelwythi Semaron
encoding document, including its explicit vowel-group inventory and accepted
Roman characters. The document refers to one font; its code table is a separate
compiler input.

`semaron-codes.json` projects the Semaron Kuriale glyph codes from
[HeroicLands/fonts](https://git.pupluppy.org/HeroicLands/fonts), commit
`4bc5eb86`, whose `fonts.json` lists each code beside its Unicode code point.
The font metadata carries the [SIL Open Font License](../script-fonts/fonts/LICENSE).

The [row-execution vectors](../encodings/README.md) exercise internal programs.
These document fixtures exercise the closed public note schema.
